# equinix_fabric_internet_access_service (Resource)

Fabric V4 API compatible resource allows creation and management of Equinix Internet Access (EIA) services.

An EIA service is attached to one or more existing Fabric connections of type IA_VC (two for DUAL_IA).

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/Internet-Access



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (Attributes) Account the service is billed to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `billing` (Attributes) Billing details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing))
- `name` (String) Name of the Internet Access service
- `project` (Attributes) Project the service belongs to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `routing_protocol` (Attributes) Routing protocol configuration of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol))
- `type` (String) Type of the Internet Access service. One of: SINGLE_IA, DUAL_IA

### Optional

- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth of the service in Mbps
- `bandwidth_commit` (Number) Minimum bandwidth commit for the burst billing variant of the service
- `order` (Attributes) Order details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--order))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Audit log of changes to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the Internet Access service
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the service. One of: PROVISIONING, PROVISIONED, FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONED
- `use_case` (String) Use case of the service. One of: MAIN, MANAGEMENT_ACCESS
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the Internet Access service

### Nested Schema for `project`

<a id="nestedatt--routing_protocol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_protocol`

Required:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Fabric IA_VC connections attached to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--connections))
- `type` (String) Routing protocol type. One of: BGP, DIRECT, STATIC

Optional:

- `asn` (Attributes) BGP only. Equinix ASN resource used on the customer side. Not read back from the API (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--asn))
- `bgp_auth_key` (String, Sensitive) BGP only. BGP authentication key. Not read back from the API
- `customer_asn` (Number) BGP only. Customer ASN number. Not read back from the API
- `customer_asn_range` (String) BGP only. Customer ASN range. One of: BITS_16, BITS_32. Not read back from the API
- `customer_routes` (Attributes List) Customer routes announced through the service, given as IP blocks (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--customer_routes))
- `export_policy` (String) BGP only. Export policy. One of: FULL, DEFAULT, FULL_DEFAULT, PARTIAL. Not read back from the API

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
